mapper.select: SELECT t.ctg_id as id, t.ctg_name as name, t.parent_ctg_id as parentId, t.sort_id as showOrder, t.is_active as isActive, t.rpt_dev_owner as rptDevOwner, t.biz_owner as bizOwner, t.oversized as oversized, t.is_module as isModule, t.ctg_desc as ctgDesc, t.etl_job as etlJob, t.data_dev_owner as dataDevOwner, t.is_auto_archive as isAutoArchive, t.data_date as dataDate, t.data_desc as dataDesc, t.module_beta_member as moduleBetaMember, t.is_test_ctg as isTestCtg, dataset.dataset_id as datasetId FROM ssd_field_ctg t left join (SELECT ctg_id, GROUP_CONCAT(dataset_id) dataset_id FROM ssm_dataset_ctg_rel GROUP BY ctg_id) dataset on dataset.ctg_id = t.ctg_id WHERE t.`ctg_type` = #{type} ORDER BY parent_ctg_id, sort_id
SELECT IFNULL(MAX(t.`sort_id`),0) FROM ssd_field_ctg t WHERE t.`parent_ctg_id` = #{parentId} and t.ctg_type = #{type}
mapper.insert: insert into ssd_field_ctg ( ctg_id, ctg_type, ctg_name, parent_ctg_id, sort_id, is_active, oversized, is_module, data_date, data_desc, ctg_desc, etl_job, created_time, created_by, rpt_dev_owner, biz_owner, data_dev_owner, is_auto_archive, module_beta_member, is_test_ctg ) values ( #{id}, #{type}, #{name}, #{parentId}, #{showOrder}, #{isActive}, #{oversized}, #{isModule}, #{dataDate}, #{dataDesc}, #{ctgDesc}, #{etlJob}, now(), #{createdBy}, #{rptDevOwner}, #{bizOwner}, #{dataDevOwner}, #{isAutoArchive}, #{moduleBetaMember}, #{isTestCtg} )
mapper.update: update ssd_field_ctg t set t.ctg_name = #{name}, t.sort_id = #{showOrder}, t.is_active = #{isActive}, t.oversized = #{oversized}, t.is_module = #{isModule}, t.ctg_desc = #{ctgDesc}, t.etl_job = #{etlJob}, t.updated_time = now(), t.updated_by = #{updatedBy}, t.parent_ctg_id = #{parentId}, t.rpt_dev_owner = #{rptDevOwner}, t.biz_owner = #{bizOwner}, t.data_dev_owner = #{dataDevOwner}, t.is_auto_archive = #{isAutoArchive}, t.data_date = #{dataDate}, t.data_desc = #{dataDesc}, t.module_beta_member = #{moduleBetaMember}, t.is_test_ctg = #{isTestCtg} where t.ctg_id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT t.ctg_id as id, t.ctg_name as name, t.parent_ctg_id as parentId, t.sort_id as showOrder, t.oversized as oversized, t.is_module as isModule, t.ctg_desc as ctgDesc, t.etl_job as etlJob, t.is_active as isActive, t.rpt_dev_owner as rptDevOwner, t.biz_owner as bizOwner, t.data_dev_owner as dataDevOwner FROM ssd_field_ctg t WHERE t.`ctg_id` = #{ctgId}

SELECT t.ctg_id as id, t.ctg_name as name, t.parent_ctg_id as parentId, t.sort_id as showOrder, t.oversized as oversized, t.is_module as isModule, t.ctg_desc as ctgDesc, t.etl_job as etlJob, t.is_active as isActive, t.rpt_dev_owner as rptDevOwner, t.biz_owner as bizOwner, t.data_dev_owner as dataDevOwner FROM ssd_field_ctg t WHERE t.`parent_ctg_id` = #{parentId} order by t.sort_id

sql.if: and ( t.`field_name` LIKE concat('%',#{searchTxt},'%') or t.field_title LIKE concat('%',#{searchTxt},'%') or t.field_code LIKE concat('%',#{searchTxt},'%') )

mapper.select:
SELECT ctg.ctg_name as ctgName, t.`field_id` as fieldId, CASE WHEN LENGTH(t.`dim_table_name`) = 0 or t.`dim_table_name` is null THEN t.`fct_table_name` ELSE t.`dim_table_name` END as tableName, t.`field_name` as fieldName, t.field_title as fieldTitle, t.`field_code` as fieldCode, ctg.rpt_dev_owner as rptDevOwner, ctg.biz_owner as bizOwner, ctg.oversized as oversized, ctg.is_module as isModule, ctg.data_dev_owner as dataDevOwner FROM ssd_field_def t LEFT JOIN ssm_field_ctg_rel rel on t.field_id = rel.field_id and rel.ctg_type = #{type} left join ssd_field_ctg ctg on rel.ctg_id = ctg.ctg_id where ctg.ctg_id is not null and rel.is_active = 1
ORDER BY t.`created_time` DESC LIMIT ${pageRowLower}, ${prePageSize}

SELECT ctg.ctg_id AS ctgId, ctg.ctg_name AS ctgName, ctg.ctg_name_path AS ctgPath, t.`field_id` AS fieldId, t.`field_name` AS fieldName, t.`field_code` AS fieldCode, t.field_title AS fieldTitle, def.table_id AS tableId, def.table_name AS tableName, def.table_owner AS tableOwner FROM ssd_field_def t LEFT JOIN ssm_field_ctg_rel rel ON t.field_id = rel.field_id AND rel.ctg_type = #{type} LEFT JOIN `v_ssd_field_ctg` ctg ON rel.ctg_id = ctg.ctg_id LEFT JOIN ssd_table_def def ON (def.`table_id` = t.`fct_table_id` OR def.`table_id` = t.`dim_table_id`) WHERE ctg.ctg_id IS NOT NULL and rel.is_active = 1
ORDER BY t.`created_time` DESC

SELECT count(1) FROM ssd_field_def t LEFT JOIN ssm_field_ctg_rel rel on t.field_id = rel.field_id and rel.ctg_type = #{type} LEFT JOIN ssd_field_ctg ctg on rel.ctg_id = ctg.ctg_id where ctg.ctg_id is not null and rel.is_active = 1
ORDER BY t.`created_time` DESC
select t.field_id from ssm_field_ctg_rel t where t.ctg_type = #{type} and t.ctg_id = #{ctgId} and t.is_active = 1
mapper.update: update ssm_field_ctg_rel t set is_active = 0, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_time = now() where t.field_id = #{fieldId} and t.ctg_id = #{ctgId}
